why: Columns 2 and 3 show the same shape in each row, but the stripes are turned a quarter turn. Row 3: lying stripes, then standing stripes. Row 1: the slant changes direction. Row 2 ends with lying stripes, so the missing house shape has standing (vertical) stripes: option 3. Options 1 and 2 have slanted stripes.
trick: When two cells show the same shape, check how the shading lines are turned.
